$description: What a PageSpec may set (style block) vs what contracts own. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_* rules.

pageSpecStyleFields.theme: light|inverse; must be one of the section contract's themes (every eligible section is light-only)

unsupportedFontsNote: font.text (Inter) is loaded but used by no preset: catalogued, not approved. Any family outside the catalog is rejected.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no hex/rgb/hsl literals anywhere in a PageSpec (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR)
rawValueRestrictions.space: no px/rem/em literals in style fields (TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING)

convention: type roles, radii, easing and springs are applied by section/component contracts, never chosen per PageSpec
maxWordsRule: Every text field's maxWords = ceil(1.25 x the largest word count of the real source strings for that field), minimum 2; recorded per field in x-maxWordsEvidence.
